user.title: Connect an intercom
user.description: Connect to a DS-KV6124-E1 on your local network.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure intercom
reconfigure.description: Leave the password empty to keep the existing password. Relay mapping can be retained or tested again in the following steps.

locks.title: Manage the active lock
locks.description: This installation uses one active physical relay per intercom. Choose camera only, test its mapping, or retain an earlier confirmed mapping.

data_description.mode: Camera-only mode creates no lock and does not permit release commands.
data_description.lock_name: Name shown in Home Assistant and Intercom Manager, such as Front door. Leave empty for the default name. Renaming while retaining the confirmed mapping does not release the lock.

mapping.title: Test the active lock
mapping.description: Stand beside the lock. Submitting with the checkbox selected sends ONE release command to the selected output. Confirm the physical result on the next screen.

data.test_unlock: I am ready to test the release now

confirm_mapping.title: Confirm the lock operation
confirm_mapping.description: The device accepted the command. Confirm that the intended lock released and returned to its normal state.

error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed. Check the account and password.
error.unsupported_device: This model or core endpoint has not been verified for this integration.
error.invalid_response: The station returned invalid data or the connection settings are invalid.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the intercom.
error.test_required: Select the release test checkbox when you are beside the lock.
error.unlock_failed: Release was not confirmed. Check the door before choosing to retry.
error.confirmation_required: Confirm the physical result before managing this lock.
error.access_removal_pending: Remove user assignments and wait for confirmed device removal before disabling this lock.

abort.unique_id_mismatch: This is a different intercom. The existing configuration was preserved.

init.title: Intercom options
init.description: By default, display uses the station time zone and daylight saving rules. A manual override changes integration display only; it does not set the device clock or NTP.

error.invalid_time_zone: Enter a valid IANA time zone, for example Asia/Jerusalem.

unlock_door.name: Release door
unlock_door.description: Momentarily release the selected active lock. The intercom controls the return duration. Requires an administrator.

lock.name: Physical lock
lock.description: Only the configured active lock (1) can be operated.

sync_user.name: Synchronize user
sync_user.description: Queue reconciliation for every station assigned to this user.

user_id.name: User ID
user_id.description: Central user UUID or station configuration entry ID.

station_id.name: Station
station_id.description: Central user UUID or station configuration entry ID.

sync_all.name: Synchronize all stations
sync_all.description: Queue independent reconciliation for all stations.

rescan_station.name: Rescan station
rescan_station.description: Read access-management capabilities and station inventory. This action does not queue synchronization or change access rights.

station_id.name: Station
station_id.description: Central user UUID or station configuration entry ID.

options.released_and_returned: The intended lock released and returned
options.choose_again: Choose an output and test again

release_in_progress.message: A release is already in progress

release_unconfirmed.message: The intercom did not confirm release; check the door before retrying

invalid_configuration.message: Invalid saved intercom configuration; reconfigure the station

identity_changed.message: The address belongs to a different intercom; reconfigure this entry

mapping_changed.message: The confirmed relay is no longer advertised; reconfigure this entry

unsupported_device.message: Unsupported intercom model or core endpoint

connection_failed.message: Intercom could not be reached or validated

target_required.message: Select an intercom device or entity

invalid_target.message: Target must belong to a Hikvision intercom

forced_lock_unsupported.message: This relay returns automatically; forced locking is not supported

access_action_failed.message: Access action could not be completed: {reason}

access_auth.title: Access management authentication failed for {station}
access_auth.description: Reconfigure the integration credentials in Settings > Devices & services. Existing device credentials were not changed.

sync_conflict.title: Synchronization needs review for {station}
sync_conflict.description: Open Intercom Manager > Sync and review the conflict. Choose the central or device version explicitly.

access_capacity.title: Access capacity reached on {station}
access_capacity.description: Review the station user/card limits and pending assignments in Intercom Manager. No existing users are removed automatically.

identity.title: Station identity changed: {station}
identity.description: The address now identifies a different station. Verify the address and configure the replacement separately. Writes are blocked.

relay_mapping.title: Relay mapping unavailable: {station}
relay_mapping.description: Reconfigure and physically confirm the active relay. No other relay is enabled automatically.

capability_regression.title: Previously observed capability missing: {station}
capability_regression.description: Check station connectivity and firmware, then reload. A previously working camera or call capability is no longer advertised.

migration.title: Configuration upgrade needs review: {station}
migration.description: The saved configuration is invalid or from a newer version. Restore a compatible backup or reinstall the matching integration version. Permissions were not changed.

users_storage_corrupt.title: Users storage requires attention
users_storage_corrupt.description: Check free space and permissions. For corrupt data, restore the matching HA backup; do not delete the private storage to reset it. Reload after repair.

users_storage_write.title: Users storage requires attention
users_storage_write.description: Check free space and permissions. For corrupt data, restore the matching HA backup; do not delete the private storage to reset it. Reload after repair.

events_storage_corrupt.title: Events storage requires attention
events_storage_corrupt.description: Check free space and permissions. For corrupt data, restore the matching HA backup; do not delete the private storage to reset it. Reload after repair.

events_storage_write.title: Events storage requires attention
events_storage_write.description: Check free space and permissions. For corrupt data, restore the matching HA backup; do not delete the private storage to reset it. Reload after repair.

schedules_storage_corrupt.title: Schedule storage could not be loaded
schedules_storage_corrupt.description: Schedule drafts are unavailable. The existing file is preserved; restore hikvision_intercom.schedules from a valid backup and restart. Existing user access continues to operate.

schedules_storage_write.title: Schedule storage write failed
schedules_storage_write.description: Check free disk space and write permissions, then save again. The change was not acknowledged as saved.

schedule_baselines_storage_corrupt.title: Schedule references unavailable
schedule_baselines_storage_corrupt.description: The schedule reference file could not be loaded. Preserve it and restore a valid backup, then restart Home Assistant. Schedule assessments and existing access remain available.

schedule_baselines_storage_write.title: Schedule reference save failed
schedule_baselines_storage_write.description: The reference could not be saved. Check storage space and permissions, then run another assessment before retrying. No station configuration was changed by this operation.
